topic: Second UI polish pass and desktop to Mac sync

Added affordability previews for seed shop, automation, and gold store purchases, including missing resources and percent progress toward the next buy.
Moved the perf/debug text panel below the HUD, goal nudge, milestone text, and trigger feed when those elements are visible.
Added small HUD chip reward celebrations for quest claims, automation purchases, seed shop purchases, satchel use, and gold store purchases.
